nodes.name: clients.php
nodes.summary: Admin client directory page: one un-paginated query joins users with bookings, payments and loyalty_cards to derive per-client booking counts, lifetime spend and first/last booking dates, then segments every client as New (0-1 bookings) or Returning (2+) with search and filter tabs. Not standalone - it calls requireRole('admin') on line 6 and relies on index.php having already loaded config.php/functions.php and defined $user.
nodes.languageNotes: Procedural page rendered as inline HTML after a closing `?>`; results are loaded in a single pass with no LIMIT/OFFSET, so the page size grows linearly with the client count.

nodes.name: dashboard.php
nodes.summary: Admin sales-and-analytics dashboard, the largest page in the project: computes revenue vs. booked sales, pending approvals, walk-in vs online split, a dynamic (capped at 24 months) monthly sales and booking trend, top-5 packages by revenue, per-package sales, busiest weekday analysis and a low-stock alert list. Roughly two thirds of its 2350 lines are inline CSS and HTML rather than PHP logic.
nodes.languageNotes: Only lines 1-323 are PHP; lines 325-1180 are an inlined <style> block and the file emits its own <!DOCTYPE html>/<head>/<body>, so when index.php requires it the page renders a nested HTML document inside the shared header/sidebar/footer layout. Charts are pure PHP-computed CSS bars - no JavaScript charting library and no fetch() calls.

nodes.name: feedback.php
nodes.summary: Admin feedback console handling delete, resolve, mark-urgent, AI re-analyze and send-reply POST actions (all CSRF-verified), calling analyzeFeedbackWithAI() from ai_helper.php and falling back to a local Tagalog/English keyword sentiment scorer when the AI columns are absent. Renders filterable review stats plus a sentiment-prioritized urgent list.
nodes.languageNotes: Probes the schema at runtime with SHOW COLUMNS FROM feedback LIKE 'ai_sentiment' / 'topics' / 'reply_sentat' style checks and degrades gracefully, so it works on installs that predate the AI and reply columns. Sending a reply both inserts a client notification (addNotification) and stamps reply_sent_at/replied_by.

nodes.name: getSegmentInfo
nodes.summary: Maps a segment name to the badge class, emoji icon, colour palette and human description used to render the New vs Returning client cards.

nodes.name: getTopicIcon
nodes.summary: Maps an AI-classified feedback topic (photographer, delivery, pricing, studio, staff, ...) to an emoji glyph, defaulting to a speech bubble.

nodes.name: getTopicLabel
nodes.summary: Returns the human-readable label for a feedback topic, falling back to ucfirst() of the raw topic value when it is not in the known set.

nodes.name: getTopicColor
nodes.summary: Returns the hex accent colour assigned to a feedback topic for badge, chip and border styling.

nodes.name: analyzeSentimentLocal
nodes.summary: Offline sentiment classifier that counts Tagalog and English positive/negative keyword hits in a comment, biases the score by star rating, and returns positive/negative/neutral when Gemini results are unavailable.

nodes.name: inventory.php
nodes.summary: Inventory CRUD page open to both admin and staff: adds items, updates quantities in place, and refuses deletion when an item is still referenced by booking_inventory rows. Every mutation calls checkLowStockAndNotify() so alerts fire immediately, and the listing annotates each item with an in-use count derived from unreturned booking_inventory records.
nodes.languageNotes: Like dashboard.php it emits a complete HTML document (lines 80-718) with its own inlined stylesheet, producing a nested document inside the router layout. The threshold logic is duplicated between the $lowItems filter on line 76 and the low-stock query in dashboard.php.

nodes.name: loyalty-cards.php
nodes.summary: Read-only admin view of the loyalty program: joins users to loyalty_cards, attaches a tier through getLoyaltyTier(), filters by the corrected 2/4/7/10 booking thresholds, and shows tier badges plus progress toward the next reward. Performs no writes and is not exposed to client or staff navigation.
nodes.languageNotes: The tier thresholds are hardcoded twice more than ideal - in the inline filters (lines 43-55) and inside getLoyaltyBadge()/getProgressToNextTier() - and must be kept in sync with getLoyaltyTier()/getLoyaltyRewards() in functions.php; the PACKAGES and LOYALTY_TIERS constants in config.php are dead code and do not drive this page.

nodes.name: getLoyaltyBadge
nodes.summary: Returns the inline-styled reward badge markup for a client based on total bookings (2+ extra minutes, 4+ extra print, 7+ extra backdrop, 10+ 50% off).

nodes.name: getProgressToNextTier
nodes.summary: Computes the percentage of progress from the client's current tier toward the next one and returns the next reward label and booking threshold, including a max-tier case.

nodes.name: notifications.php
nodes.summary: Shared notification inbox for admin, staff and clients: opens a notification (marking it read and redirecting to its internal link), marks all as read, deletes single entries, and renders the latest 100 notifications styled per type. Every branch prefers the functions.php helper (getNotifications, markNotificationRead, markAllNotificationsRead, deleteNotification) and falls back to equivalent inline SQL.
nodes.languageNotes: Unlike its sibling admin pages it does not call requireRole() - it uses a conditional requireLogin() and resolves the identity via `$user ?? currentUser()`, bailing out with an inline error block when no user id is available. isSafeNotificationLink() only accepts relative index.php?page=... targets, guarding stored notification links against open redirects. Push delivery (sendPushNotification in functions.php) silently no-ops because Minishlink\WebPush is absent from vendor/.

nodes.name: isSafeNotificationLink
nodes.summary: Validates a notification's stored link, permitting only relative internal index.php?page=... targets and rejecting absolute URLs, protocol-relative links and javascript: style values before redirecting.

nodes.name: formatNotificationDate
nodes.summary: Formats a notification timestamp as 'M d, Y - h:i A', returning the raw string untouched when the value cannot be parsed.

nodes.name: getNotificationIcon
nodes.summary: Chooses the emoji shown for a notification, preferring the stored icon column and otherwise deriving one from the notification type (booking, payment, inventory, feedback, urgent_feedback, new_client, photo, system).

nodes.name: getNotificationTypeClass
nodes.summary: Maps a notification type to the CSS class (type-booking, type-payment, type-inventory, type-feedback, type-client, type-photo, type-system) consumed by the page's inlined stylesheet.

nodes.name: packages.php
nodes.summary: Admin CRUD page over the packages table: creates and updates packages with an image upload, soft-deletes them by setting is_active=0, and renders main packages with their sub-packages grouped through parent_id. Images are stored under assets/packages/ with a validated MIME type and a random filename.
nodes.languageNotes: Upload validation is content-based (finfo MIME sniff rather than the client-supplied Content-Type), capped at 5MB, with pkg_<timestamp>_<random hex> filenames; replacing or removing an image unlinks the old file. Delete is a soft delete - the row stays but is_active=0, while child sub-packages are only detached client-side.

nodes.name: handleImageUpload
nodes.summary: Validates and stores an uploaded package image: 5MB size cap, finfo MIME allow-list for JPEG/PNG/GIF/WebP, randomized filename under assets/packages/, and a flash message on any failure path.

nodes.name: payments.php
nodes.summary: Admin payment ledger: aggregates total revenue, pending, refunded and unpaid-reservation figures from the payments and bookings tables, then lists transactions joined to clients, bookings, packages and the users who refunded or verified them, with a status filter and derived on-site vs walk-in source labels.
nodes.languageNotes: Defines a local RESERVATION_FEE = 100 constant and interpolates it straight into SQL (safe because it is a literal, unlike the bound parameters); the unpaid-reservation total is derived as fee x unpaid bookings rather than read from stored deposits, so it can drift from actual payment records. Mutating payment actions live in pages/api/record-payment.php, not here.
